name: ntfs-browser
description: A modernized, read-only C++20 library for parsing NTFS volumes directly from raw disk and MFT structures.

tests.description: Pull in Catch2 and nlohmann/json for NtfsBrowserTests and the tools (NTFS_BROWSER_USE_INSTALLED_CATCH2, NTFS_BROWSER_USE_INSTALLED_NLOHMANN_JSON)

regex.description: Pull in PCRE2 for regular expression search (NTFS_BROWSER_USE_INSTALLED_PCRE2, NTFS_BROWSER_ENABLE_REGEX)

efs-cryptopp.description: Pull in Crypto++ for the EFS Crypto++ cipher backend (NTFS_BROWSER_USE_INSTALLED_CRYPTOPP, NTFS_BROWSER_ENABLE_EFS_CRYPTOPP)
